mechanism: Empagliflozin increases urinary glucose excretion and osmotic diuresis, which may worsen glycemic control in testosterone-treated patients; testosterone can increase sodium reabsorption and fluid retention, potentially counteracting SGLT2 inhibitor benefits and increasing cardiovascular risk.
action: Monitor blood glucose control, blood pressure, and fluid status closely; assess for signs of volume expansion or heart failure; consider alternative androgen therapy if glycemic control becomes problematic.
